name: Zombie Isles
summary: Zombie Isles is a survival game for Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad, with controls built for each device and progress that syncs between them. Survive endless waves of zombies across nine islands, scavenging weapons and secret items and fighting bosses on land and sea, across more than twenty game modes including an endless arena, generator defense, a 25-floor gauntlet, eleven natural disasters, rated duels and tournaments, a last-one-standing showdown and capture the flag.
